# Scenarios

Authored renderer scenarios: extractions, or before and after extractions with an optional comparator, shown with a renderer. Paths are relative to this file. Scenario IDs are unique within the file. The schema is published at its ID, `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/scenarios/v0.json`; it is generated from TypeBox
definitions into [`packages/schemas/schemas/scenarios/v0.json`](../../../packages/schemas/schemas/scenarios/v0.json).

## Document

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | `"projections.scenarios"` | Yes |  |
| `version` | `0` | Yes |  |
| `title` | [`title`](#title) |  | Default group for this file's scenarios. |
| `renderer` | [`renderer`](#renderer) |  | Default renderer for scenarios that omit one. |
| `scenarios` | array of [`scenario`](#scenario) | Yes | At most 1000 items. |

No other properties are allowed.

Further rules depend on these values; see the JSON Schema for them.

## Definitions

### `title`

Type: string. At least 1 character. At most 1000 characters.

### `path`

A path relative to the scenarios file. `..` segments are allowed; absolute paths, URLs, backslashes and control characters are not.

Type: string. Pattern `^(?!/)(?!.*//)(?!.*\/$)(?!.*[\\\u0000-\u001f\u007f])[^?#:]+$`. At least 1 character. At most 1024 characters.

### `renderer`

Type: [`identifier`](definition.md#identifier) or object.

### `extraction`

An inline extraction, or the path (relative to the scenarios file) of a JSON file holding an extraction or a `projections.extraction` document, whose `extraction` is used.

Type: [`path`](#path) or [Extraction](extraction.md).

### `comparator`

A comparator file (`<name>.comparator.yaml`) by path relative to the scenarios file, as a string or `{file, options}`; an object without `file` is the default comparator with options.

Type: object or [`path`](#path) and string or object.

### `scenario`

One authored renderer scenario: a single extraction, or before and after extractions.

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Yes | Unique within the file and safe as a file name. Pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,99}$`. |
| `title` | [`title`](#title) | Yes |  |
| `group` | [`title`](#title) |  | Overrides the document title for grouping. |
| `description` | string |  | At least 1 character. At most 4096 characters. |
| `renderer` | [`renderer`](#renderer) |  | A renderer name, or a bundle directory relative to the scenarios file. Defaults to the document's. |
| `before` | [`extraction`](#extraction) |  |  |
| `after` | [`extraction`](#extraction) |  |  |
| `extraction` | [`extraction`](#extraction) |  |  |
| `comparator` | [`comparator`](#comparator) |  | Only with before and after. |
| `presentation` | [`presentation`](definition.md#presentation) |  |  |

No other properties are allowed.
